use default

factorize(text: string) -> Pipe[string] is
    let start mut = 0

    while start < text.length do
        let compare mut = start + 1
        let anchor mut = start

        while compare < text.length /\ text[anchor] <= text[compare] do
            if text[anchor] < text[compare] then
                anchor = start
            else
                anchor = anchor + 1
            fi
            compare = compare + 1
        od

        let width = compare - anchor

        while start <= anchor do
            yield text[start .. start + width]
            start = start + width
        od
    od
